insights.one_liner: BYD Europe is the Hoofddorp-based European arm of Chinese electric-vehicle and battery maker BYD, an IND-recognised sponsor whose jobs here are all in English.

culture.text: Staff on LinkedIn mostly studied business, economics, marketing or mechanical engineering, at places like University of Amsterdam, TU Delft, VU Amsterdam and Politecnico di Milano.
The most common jobs are in operations, sales, engineering, IT and customer support.
It is a regional office of a huge group: postings say BYD employs over 300,000 people worldwide, with headquarters in Shenzhen, China.
Its 4 open jobs here are all in Hoofddorp, spread over HR, sales, project management and finance, from internship to senior level.

open.text: BYD Europe B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor, so it can sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa.
All 4 of its current postings here are open to people who don't speak Dutch.
Postings describe a diverse team and BYD Europe is the group's first overseas subsidiary, founded in 1998.

growth.text: LinkedIn lists 1,338 employees on its page for BYD Europe.
Headlines say BYD is close to outselling Ford in Europe.
BYD is reported to be very interested in taking over Menarini's bus plant in Flumeri, Italy, as European factory plans take shape.

worth_knowing.text: BYD Europe's managing director left to become Ford of Europe's sales boss in July 2026.
BYD was added to a U.S. defense listing, and the EU discussed a cap on plug-in hybrids.
